{kra_link}

name: link from performance settings to new kra and goal setup
script:
# Ambil nama dokumen yang sedang aktif saat tombol diklik
docname = frappe.form_dict.get('docname')

if docname:
    # 1. Jalankan fungsi kirim email blast asli di background server
    frappe.get_doc("Performance Settings", docname).kirim_blast_appraisal()
    
    # 2. Ambil data dokumen tersebut untuk dibaca nilainya
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Performance Settings", docname)
    company = doc.company
    cycle_year = doc.cycle_year
    
    # 3. Definisikan URL tujuan ke halaman form BARU beserta parameter auto-fill
    target_url = f"/app/performance-settings/new?company={frappe.utils.cstr(company)}&cycle_year={frappe.utils.cstr(cycle_year)}"
    
    # 4. Paksa response server untuk melakukan redirect keras ke halaman baru
    frappe.local.response["redirect_to"] = target_url
    frappe.local.response["type"] = "redirect"
    frappe.response["message"] = {"redirect_to": target_url}
